RYS Upper Promenade Outfield review: "Outfield views do not get any further than in the Upper Promenade Outfield sections. Exclusive to the left field side and located on the highest tier of seating beyond the outfield wall, these seats will not only have a difficult time following the action, but also have a tough angle to the center field videoboard. Entry tunnels are located at the front of these 17 row sections, and if you don't mind sitting almost as far as possible you can find some overhead coverage in the very last rows." Seating Notes: "Rows 11 and above are under cover." For concerts: "533 is behind the stage or to the side of the stage for most concerts. This may restrict or limit your view of the performance."

Fan review (Sec 534, Row 1, Baseball, 5 stars, titled "Avoid the front row on the 500 level"): "Both the safety railing and walkway hand rail were right in my view of the infield, making for a very frustrating view at the ballpark. Left field corner or deep on the left field wall - no chance of seeing anything there. Scoreboard views are incredibly difficult, and be prepared with sunscreen during a day game as you see a healthy amount of sun. I usually try like sitting near the entryway to a section for quick trips to the concourse, and I always love sitting on an aisle, but that is a recipe for disaster here in Section 534 Row 1 Seat 1." For concerts: "534 is behind the stage or to the side of the stage for most concerts. This may restrict or limit your view of the performance."
